name: Fading
summary: Dark magic drains your substance, making you stealthier and harder to see but duller in presence and pained by light.
description: Creatures touched by the pale cold of dark places begin to come loose from the world. At first they only look wan and a little off, as if remembered rather than seen. As the fading deepens they thin into shadows of themselves, until nothing is left but a shape that the dark can swallow whole.

effects.name: Fading Stages
effects.text: This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Fading stage, to a maximum of 6. Finishing a {ref:glossary/long-rest} removes 1 Fading stage. When your Fading stage reaches 0, the condition ends.

effects.name: Dimmed Presence
effects.text: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, the roll is increased by your Fading stage. When you make a Charisma check or a Charisma saving throw, the roll is reduced by your Fading stage.

effects.name: Sensitivity to Light
effects.text: If your Fading stage is 2 or higher, you have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight while you are in {ref:glossary/bright-light}. If your Fading stage is 4 or higher, you also have Disadvantage on attack rolls while you are in Bright Light.

effects.name: Shadow Form
effects.text: If your Fading stage is 6, you have lost your physical form and are a living shadow. You have the {ref:condition/invisible} condition while you are in {ref:glossary/dim-light} or {ref:glossary/darkness}, and any equipment you are wearing or carrying becomes a shadow with you.
